description: Create an affiliate campaign: what affiliates earn per sale and where their links send people. Returns the campaign and its joinUrl, the link to share with affiliates so they can sign up. Confirm the commission with the user before calling. A new campaign is active at once and, unless isPublic is false, listed in LinkJolt's Discovery marketplace where affiliates browse programs. Recurring commissions pay on renewals too. The plan's campaign limit applies. Requires Pro plan or higher; live keys only.

autoApproveAffiliates.description: Approve affiliates who join through the join link without review (default false)

commissionType.description: Percentage of the sale, or a fixed amount per sale

commissionValue.description: The percent (e.g. 20) or the fixed amount in the brand currency (e.g. 30)

description.description: What the program offers, shown to affiliates

enableRecurringCommissions.description: Also pay commission on subscription renewals (default false)

isPublic.description: List the campaign in the Discovery marketplace (default true)

name.description: Campaign name affiliates see, at least 2 characters

recurringCommissionCount.description: Payments that pay commission, including the first; omit for no limit

recurringCommissionDurationMonths.description: Months of renewals that pay commission; omit for no limit

recurringCommissionMode.description: Limit renewals by months since the first sale, or by number of payments (default duration)

recurringCommissionType.description: Renewals pay the same rate as the first sale, or a custom rate (default same)

recurringCommissionValue.description: The renewal rate when recurringCommissionType is custom

targetUrl.description: Where affiliate links send people, usually the business's website or pricing page

name: create_campaign
title: Create campaign
